Reference: AM-CAREERS

Questions, Answered

Everything before you apply.

Every application is reviewed by our talent team within 48 business hours. Shortlisted candidates meet us twice — a craft conversation with the team lead and a coffee chat with the founders — then we move to an offer. Most candidates hear back inside two weeks.

Yes. We hire on craft and appetite, not just years on a CV. Graduates and interns with a strong portfolio, personal projects or a distinctive point of view are always welcome — a few of our best people started here straight out of college.

Most roles are hybrid: two days a week in our Petaling Jaya studio for the energy and the espresso, the rest wherever you do your sharpest thinking. Freelancers and fully remote specialists are considered for selected production roles.

One short form, your CV and — for creative, web and video roles — a link to your portfolio. Some teams ask for a small craft exercise after the first conversation. There is no online aptitude test and no endless panel interview.

We are based in Malaysia and hire candidates who already hold the right to work here. For senior roles we can support the employment pass process case by case — tell us in your application and we will be honest about what is possible.

Our studio is in Petaling Jaya, minutes from Kuala Lumpur. Core hours are 10am to 7pm with flexibility around shoots, launches and event weekends — event life is seasonal, and we plan the quiet weeks to balance the loud ones.
